cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: I Know How to Fix Us
cards.instruction: Perform confidence about repairing the relationship while improvising every step.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've put my coat on like you. A fresh-air reset; we'll have last night's argument fixed before we reach the corner.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm leaving. My bus comes in five minutes.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, a short reset. I'll walk you to the stop and you can tell me what I missed.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You missed me saying I need five minutes without you talking.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Right, the quiet part first. I'll walk on the other side of the pavement; wave if you want the talking part.

reason: Replace stock certainty with a particular copied misunderstanding that shapes concealment, disclosure order, healthy-break framing, or improvised relationship repair; keep B consequential.
